answer.why: The light wood table, black wooden chairs, white bell pendant and light-fronted low sideboard form a calm, uncluttered Nordic dining set. Their light woods and whites harmonize with the pale walls and grey-brown floor, while the black chairs and pendant add a restrained contrast.
